notes: Optimised one-step reference (T-005 round 3, 8.4a), read by ReferenceGait at imp = 2: linear in Froude between rows (clamped to 0.10..0.20), linear in phase. Generated by Tools/GaitOpt/export_reference.py; do not edit by hand.

conventions.model: Planar sagittal model of Tools/GaitOpt/stride_opt.py: q = [hip x, hip height, upper-body forward lean th, leg (thigh a_t, shank a_s, foot f) x2]. x forward, z up. Angles a_t, a_s from the downward vertical, positive = distal end ahead; f = foot pitch, positive = heel up (toes down). Both hips coincide at one point (no hip width, no lateral motion).
conventions.angles: hip_deg = a_t + th (flexion, positive = thigh forward of the trunk); knee_deg = a_t - a_s (flexion, positive = bent, 0 = straight); ankle_deg = a_s + f (plantarflexion, positive = toes down relative to the shank). Rates are the time derivatives of these. foot_pitch_deg = f (absolute, positive = toes down). pelvis_pitch_deg = th, positive = leaning forward.
conventions.mapping_to_reference_gait: Intended identical to ReferenceGait's LegSample: HipFlexion = line angle + alpha + PelvisTilt (thigh forward positive, plus the pelvic tilt), Knee = flexion positive, AnklePlantar = foot pitch + shank angle with FootPitch positive = toes down. Signs match by reading both definitions; NOT verified against the Unity joint axes. 8.5 verifies the mapping in Unity.
conventions.torques: tau is the generalised force the actuator supplies conjugate to the joint angle as defined above (positive = torque in the direction of increasing hip flexion, knee flexion, ankle plantarflexion); joint power = tau x rate. N m, as in the solver (body data units). Sign against Unity joint axes is NOT verified (8.5).
conventions.forces: Per foot, heel and toe sole points: fn = normal force (N, >= 0), ft = tangential (horizontal, in-plane) force (N), positive = forward on the foot. Contact flags are the solver's schedule (heel: heel point loaded; toe: toe point loaded; both = flat).
conventions.roles: Leg B of the solver is 'stance': heel strike at node 0, flat, then toe rocker until node N. Leg A is 'swing': toe rocker for nodes 0..k_ds, then swing until its heel strike at node N. Node N is node 0 with stance and swing swapped (mirrored periodic boundary); pelvis_x_m advances by step_length_m. In ReferenceGait the left leg is stance during the first half stride (stride phase 0..0.5), the right leg during the second half.
conventions.frame: pelvis_x_rel_m and ankle_x_m are in a frame moving at the mean walking speed v, origin at the mean hip position (periodic: node N equals node 0 with legs swapped). pelvis_x_m is the solver's absolute x. phase = k / N over one step (N = 40).
conventions.units: m, s, N, N m, degrees and degrees/s. Mech data of the balanced frame (leg length 42.4 m); other sizes scale time by sqrt(l/42.4) and lengths by l/42.4 in ReferenceGait (forces and torques are not rescaled).
